problem: Internal research_enrichment accumulated as prepared/suggested while users observed no provider-backed commercial output.
root_cause: Research and external execution shared the sales-action lifecycle but stale internal research had no mandatory terminal OBSERVE decision; external non-email actions could also remain nonterminal without explicit executor ownership.
failed_approach: Treat scheduler activity, generated research, merged content or prepared actions as evidence of commercial execution.
fix: Canonical runtime watchdog powerhouse_commercial_action_closure_watchdog_v1 terminalizes stale internal research as evidence-backed OBSERVE/expired.
Overdue external non-email actions become WAIT and remain owned until provider proof or an explicit terminal decision.
Watchdog runs every 10 minutes under existing Supabase scheduler control; no parallel CRM or outbound queue.
Daily assurance must count provider proof separately from intelligence/preparation.

prevention.invariant: No stale research_enrichment may remain suggested/prepared/waiting; research is not commercial success. External execution is terminal only with provider proof or explicit evidence-backed terminal decision.
prevention.duplicate_safety: No provider mutation is performed by the lifecycle watchdog; existing channel executors retain dedupe/idempotency authority.

evaluation.method: runtime readback after first watchdog execution
